title: Glowing present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Box body -->
  <rect x='18' y='46' width='64' height='42' rx='4' fill='#ff4f7b'/>
  <!-- Box body shading -->
  <rect x='18' y='46' width='64' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <rect x='18' y='80' width='64' height='8' rx='4' fill='#d62d5c'/>
  <!-- Lid -->
  <rect x='14' y='36' width='72' height='14' rx='4' fill='#ff6f96'/>
  <rect x='14' y='36' width='72' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ffb3c8'/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon -->
  <rect x='44' y='36' width='12' height='52' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='44' y='36' width='4' height='52' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <rect x='52' y='36' width='4' height='52' fill='#ffd11a'/>
  <!-- Horizontal ribbon -->
  <rect x='14' y='50' width='72' height='10' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='14' y='50' width='72' height='3' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <rect x='14' y='57' width='72' height='3' fill='#ffd11a'/>
  <!-- Bow loops -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(-20 38 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(20 62 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffd11a' transform='rotate(-20 38 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffd11a' transform='rotate(20 62 28)'/>
  <!-- Bow tails -->
  <path d='M46 36 L38 46 L44 46 Z' fill='#ffd11a'/>
  <path d='M54 36 L62 46 L56 46 Z' fill='#ffd11a'/>
  <!-- Bow knot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#ffd11a'/>
  <!-- Glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='2' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='2' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='2.5' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe6'/>
</svg>
